contracts: Node and edge property field sets must respectively agree with compatible recursive domains. Join nullability and extents without implicit missing-property completion. Empty graphs retain their contracts.
input: Every present entity record contains every declared property; a missing entity is not a record with missing properties.

strategies.exact_equal: Require typed equality, including null/null, and return the value.
strategies.number_sum: Add two finite number values, including when equal.
strategies.number_mean: Compute the binary pairwise average of two finite number values, not a multi-sample global mean.
strategies.number_min: Return the minimum of two finite number values.
strategies.number_max: Return the maximum of two finite number values.
strategies.set_union: Return the union of typed-value equality classes of two arrays in canonical typed-value order.
strategies.set_difference: Return left typed-value equality classes absent from the right array in canonical typed-value order.

null: Nullable numeric/array property domains may be checked, but an actual null operand fails before publication when its strategy is applied. No zero or empty-array substitution. Nullable item values remain legal set members.
union: Keep complete one-sided entities unchanged. For shared identities apply every explicit property strategy even to equal values; unlisted properties require typed equality.
subtraction: Keep left-only entities; ignore right-only entities. For shared identities with no nonempty strategy map for the entity kind, remove equal complete payloads and fail on conflict. With a nonempty map, apply named strategies and equality for unlisted properties, retaining the transformed entity even if unchanged or all values are zero/empty. Strategy names retain their union meaning, including number_sum as addition. Node and edge maps are independent.
endpoint_closure: After subtraction remove remaining edges whose endpoints are absent from retained nodes; never resurrect deleted nodes. This does not alter apply_graph_delta admission.
conditional_laws: Union idempotence and subtraction self-annihilation are not unconditional under explicit field strategies. No strategy map gives ordinary exact-payload removal for subtract(g,g); an explicit sum map gives transformed retained entities.
